title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1912. inv. no 724 (1911) from Yeni Camii, Sivas, Turkey. 255 x 717 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 60.
